newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume eases on weaker demand.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume eases on weaker demand.

text.p: Traded volume on the Istanbul gold exchange eased to 960 kilos on Tuesday from Monday's 1035 on low demand, despite weaker prices.
Gold closed at $358.70 an ounce, down from $360.20 on Monday, while lira price was unchanged at 1,265,500.
There was little change in the lira's position against the dollar either, closing at 109,460 lira to the dollar after Monday's 109,480.

Morning trade in gold totalled 850 kilos with 110 kilos changing hands in the afternoon when no dollar-term trade took place. 72.4 percent of trade was conducted in lira terms. --Istanbul newsroom +90-212-2750875.
